source_identity: A mapping registry entry (source_system + source customer key) resolves to exactly one PostgreSQL customer.
same_customer_rule: If BDM and TMP resolve to the same PostgreSQL customer, do not create a duplicate customer.

master_data_precedence.rule: For the same resolved customer, use only customer-master values from TMP. TMP overwrites BDM; BDM is retained only as a source mapping and transaction reference, not as a master-data fallback.

bdm_solo_dist.when: The BDM customer is already resolved to one verified existing PostgreSQL customer.

write_order: Apply TMP customer updates last when both sources resolve to the same customer.

manual_customer_queue.rule: Only TMP manual customer rows may create or update PostgreSQL customer master data.
manual_customer_queue.bdm_solo_dist: Reference only for manual rows. Do not create or update a customer master record from a BDM manual row. This does not block an already verified BDM-to-existing-PostgreSQL match from being overwritten.

bdm_candidate_name_resolution.match_rule: Match normalized source store name to normalized PostgreSQL candidate store name.
